'''Corellian lum''' was a type of [[Lum/Legends|lum]] of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] variety. The [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]-based [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] union leader [[Glor Jal]] could be bribed with a shot of Corellian lum.
